# M4A1 model

Imported from the user-provided `gun-m4a1.zip`.

- Original FBX: `Models/Gun_M41D.fbx`
- Original diffuse texture: `Textures/M4_D.png`
- URP Lit material: `Materials/M4A1.mat`
- Ready-to-place visual prefab: `Prefabs/M4A1.prefab`

The prefab is centred at its pivot and scaled to 0.84 Unity units along its longest axis. The original FBX geometry and texture are retained. One renderer, 3,269 vertices, 2,965 triangles. No gameplay scripts or colliders are attached.
